title: Milos stability repair
details: Removed the standard UI MutationObserver that could repeatedly rewrite the home DOM and freeze Milos
Removed the second UI observer so menu rendering is handled by the core app rather than competing background patches
The Milos avatar now opens through the core single-click route without synthetic touch handlers
Updates are now non-blocking and no longer use a full-screen installer or cache polling loop
A clean 2.36 offline shell replaces the broken 2.35 cached runtime
